title: European register for rare vascular diseases
summary: The aim of this study is to gain a better understanding of the development of rare vascular diseases and to improve therapy and aftercare recommendations.

interventions.name: The register on rare vascular diseases is intended to retrospectively collect and collate data already collected on patient care.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Confirmed diagnosis of a rare vascular disease
Exclusion criteria:
Insufficient anonymization or possible identification of the individual due to demographic data and rarity of the diagnosis
